text: Do a research pass on the internet with the librarian and download what you find into research/sources/. This is an integer-ratio / Diophantine feasibility problem over supplier spoilage rates; fetch the governing theory rather than deriving it from scratch - rational solutions to linear systems with integrality constraints, Farey/Stern-Brocot mediant structure for bounding rational ratios, and standard treatments of simultaneous linear Diophantine equations. Record the source URL in every downloaded file and file what each establishes as a claim block.
